_comment: Bot-pool project registry. Copy this file to projects.json and fill in real values. Maps each project to the Telegram chat (group) it is reachable from. Optional -- single-project deployments do not need this file at all.

_comment_fields.chat_id: Telegram chat/group id this project's bots post to and listen in. Get it by messaging @userinfobot or checking getUpdates.
_comment_fields.state_dir: Absolute path to this project's state/ directory.
_comment_fields.project_dir: Absolute path to this project's root directory (the overlay, not framework-repo).
_comment_fields.dispatcher_prompt: Absolute path to this project's shared/prompts/dispatcher_system.md.
